status: Synthetic canvas transition storyboard; not an implemented animation or renderer.
notes: Each final PNG is copied unchanged from the built-in output directory. Original outputs remain there. No raster post-processing. Figures 1–3 request one fixed camera and separate stable object anchors; generated pixels approximate that invariant.

images.title: Process emphasis at the shared location
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a spacious high-fidelity Board map screenshot, landscape 16:9, showing PROCESS emphasis with one resource selected as context. This is the FIRST frame of a fixed-camera process-to-resource transition study.
Input image 1 is the PROCESS MATERIAL reference only: warm ivory continuous fabric, broad inbox shoulders, narrower outbox wells, restrained amber tint ONLY on inner well walls.
Input image 2 is the EXACT CAMERA, GEOMETRY FOOTPRINT AND UI FRAME reference. Preserve its camera angle, viewport extent, all object ground positions, labels, three dashed association paths, selected R17 perimeter, full header and selection card. Do not add any objects.
Keep the population "3 resources · 3 processes", "Synthetic · complete" state and scope "Atlas / A.01". Keep the exact resource card unchanged: Resource R17; 2 Tables · shared resource; Current values 32 MiB; Writer PID 41; Lifetime Independent; 3 visible associations; Open resource.
Change only these map representations:
1. On R17's SAME selected rectangular footprint, flatten both T1 and T2 buildings into FLUSH rectangular floor-plan plates with their T1/T2 labels retained. There are no raised walls or roofs. R17 remains a resource with the same boundary, not a process funnel.
2. Flatten R18's modular building into a flush geometric floor-plan plate on its same site. Flatten R19's stepped building into a flush floor-plan plate on its same site. Keep the resource labels.
3. Replace the circular PID 41 marker at lower left with a BROAD SOFT INBOX SHOULDER whose narrower OUTBOX WELL is inset in that SAME shoulder. Give its inner well walls restrained amber age tint. The horizontal center stays fixed at the original PID41 disk. Label PID41 remains outside the form and readable.
4. PID 52 at lower middle becomes a smaller SOFT ROUNDED MOUND with NO well, representing inbox only; same horizontal center.
5. PID 63 at upper left becomes a SMALL DEPRESSION below the neutral fabric with NO positive mound, representing outbox only. Subtle amber inner wall tint, same center.
Make all three process forms modest in size, not overlapping the R17 footprint. Keep dashed association lines visible on the neutral ground between their actual anchors and R17. No building sits on or within a process shoulder.
Bottom-left legend becomes ONE compact white control card: top row a segmented switch "Processes" selected in dark teal and "Resources" unselected. Below, text "Inbox ↑  Outbox ↓" and a small age strip labeled "Oldest output". No separate layer selector elsewhere. This legend remains comfortably small. All remaining controls, typography, material and whitespace unchanged. Footer "Concept · synthetic data".
This is illustrative geometry, not a calibrated plot. Do not show numeric queue values, because the selected card is for R17. Do not duplicate card numbers elsewhere. No left rail, mini-map, trees, roads, or extra charts.

images.title: A neutral handoff preserves separate identities
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Edit this Board screenshot into the NEUTRAL HANDOFF frame of a process-to-resource emphasis switch. Preserve the EXACT camera, extent, header, population, resource card, R17 selected outline, all ground footprints and labels, three association paths, and UI positions. Do not zoom, pan or rotate; do not move or duplicate anything.
Flatten the three soft process landforms at PID41, PID52 and PID63 into simple FLAT circular identity anchors at the SAME horizontal centers. Remove all amber well-wall coloration and all raised shoulders/depressions. Keep the resource floor-plan plates exactly as they are, still flat; do NOT erect buildings yet. Thus both processes and resources have identifiable flat anchors for a brief presentation handoff. Flatness does NOT mean zero measured counts.
In the EXISTING bottom-left control card, keep the Processes / Resources segmented control at the same position. Now Resources is dark-teal selected and Processes is unselected. Replace the entire metric row and age gradient beneath it with just "Switching to Resources" in readable muted teal. No active height scale is shown during the handoff. Keep the exact R17 card with 32 MiB and all its other fields unchanged; that value is authoritative within the synthetic scenario throughout.
Footer "Concept · synthetic data". Add no new panels, headings, numbers, markers or overlays. The transition is a change in presentation, not data draining or a resource being created. Calm high-end ivory material, identical framing and whitespace.

images.title: Resource emphasis at the same camera
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Input image 1 is the EXACT TARGET FRAME: the Board process-emphasis screenshot. Input image 2 is a BUILDING SHAPE REFERENCE ONLY from the previous shared-resource study.
Edit image 1 into the RESOURCE EMPHASIS endpoint of a fixed-camera switch. Preserve image 1's exact camera, extent, header, population, selection card, labels, resource footprints, three association paths and all UI positions. No zoom, pan, rotation, new objects or re-layout.
Flatten PID41, PID52 and PID63 into simple circular process identity anchors at their SAME ground centers. Remove their queue relief and amber tint. These remain selectable context anchors, not zero-queue claims.
At the EXISTING R17 footprint, erect two connected modest-height rectangular Table wings on the same shared foundation, like image 2, with labels T1 and T2. Keep R17's dark-teal perimeter and R17 label in their existing locations.
At the EXISTING R18 footprint, erect a compact modular KV mass of interlocking cubes like image 2. At the EXISTING R19 footprint, erect a stepped/terraced Document form like image 2. Do not relocate the footprint to the source reference if it differs. All resource height starts at neutral ground; no building rises out of a process well.
Bottom-left EXISTING segmented control: "Processes" unselected, "Resources" selected in dark teal. Replace the inbox/outbox metric and age strip with "Current value bytes" and a smaller second line "Height: compressed · Footprint: layout". Keep the control card compact at its existing position. Preserve the entire exact selected R17 card, including "Current values 32 MiB".
Footer "Concept · synthetic data". Calm ivory architectural material, muted slate accents, no amber, trees, roads, extra charts or panels. This is the same place and selected identity with a different map emphasis.

images.title: Zoom reveals detail without changing emphasis
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Edit this Board RESOURCE EMPHASIS screenshot into a CLOSER SEMANTIC ZOOM view focused on the SAME selected resource R17. This time the camera DOES move closer and becomes almost top-down. Keep the full header, search box, Map / Browse switch, right-side camera controls, existing top-right R17 selection card and bottom-left Processes / Resources control. Resources stays selected. No extra panels.
The neutral floor-plan of R17 should now fill most of the open area to the left of the selection card, leaving generous whitespace. FLATTEN the two Table wings into two readable flat inset plates on the SAME shared site. Preserve their separate labels "T1" and "T2"; beneath each label put only "Table". No row grids, invented schema, business data or separate byte numbers. Keep one dark-teal R17 perimeter and an R17 identity label. At reading distance buildings become legible metadata, not towering blocks.
Keep PID41, PID52 and PID63 as three quiet FLAT circular anchors around R17, connected by the same three dashed association paths. Because the camera is closer, R18 and R19 are now beyond the viewport; do not draw them or their labels. Do not imply they were deleted. No new processes or resources.
Replace the small population text at the top of the canvas with "Visible: 1 resource · 3 processes". Keep "Synthetic · complete". Preserve scope "Atlas / A.01" in the main header.
Keep the selected card's text exactly: "Resource R17", "2 Tables · shared resource", "Current values 32 MiB", "Writer PID 41", "Lifetime Independent", "3 visible associations", "Open resource". This is the same identity and unchanged value as the previous frame.
The bottom-left compact control keeps "Processes" unselected and "Resources" selected. Below use the text "Resource detail" and a smaller line "Relief flattened for reading". No quantitative height scale at this flat detail distance.
Footer "Concept · synthetic data".
Warm ivory, soft shadows only around inset plate edges, crisp restrained slate type, teal only for selection. Spacious high-fidelity interface, 16:9 landscape. No deep perspective, raised buildings, wells, amber age coloration, left rail, minimap, duplicate inspector or charts. This is a zoom within Resources; it does not automatically enter Browse or change any data.
